description: Token holdings for a wallet with balances, USD values, and 24h price change where available. Likely spam airdrops are hidden and counted (include_spam=true shows them). EVM chains route through CoinGecko (eth, base, bsc, polygon_pos, arbitrum, optimism, avax, linea, stable, robinhood, arc) with Alchemy as the fallback; Solana wallets are detected automatically and route through Helius.

address.description: Required. Wallet address (0x… for EVM, base58 for Solana).

chain.description: Chain name, for example "eth", "base", "arbitrum", or "solana". Defaults to eth for 0x addresses; Solana is auto-detected.

include_spam.description: Show likely spam airdrops (tokens with a URL or claim lure in the name, and on EVM chains tokens with no market price). Default false; the response says how many were hidden.

response_format.description: concise (default) returns the trimmed essentials; detailed returns the full provider payload. json and markdown, the platform-wide values every other tool advertises, are accepted and treated as concise.

name: get_wallet_portfolio

token_count.description: Total holdings found, which may exceed tokens.length.

tokens.description: Holdings; truncated in concise mode when note is present.

title: Get Wallet Portfolio
